command: session new; network load file file=<file>; view set current (the largest view); hide the WEST, SOUTH and EAST panels; resize the main window until the view is 1200 x 900; view fit content; GET /v1/networks/{net}/views/{view}.svg

network.title: Hierarchy (U2OS images and STRING PPIs) with HPA annotations
network.chosen: the view with the most nodes
network.style: Hierarchy (U2OS images and STRING PPIs) with HPA annotations-Style

fonts: the style's own font names, written into <text> as Java names them (for example Dialog.bold, SansSerif.plain); label wrapping was measured by Java with the JRE's fonts
svgPostprocessing: none: the SVG is Cytoscape's output byte for byte
loads: two loads, each in a new session, drew the same SVG (in any element order, numbers within 1 px)
